sloka: ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः ।परुषं परुषा नार्य ऊचुस्ता वाक्यमप्रियम् ।। ५.२२.१।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sītāmupāgamya rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ ।paruṣaṁ paruṣā nārya ūcustā vākyamapriyam ।। 5.22.1।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the sharp words of pleasing Sita, the lord of demons replied in unpleasant terms:
